glosses: A washing, especially of the skin for the purpose of beautification.
To cover or treat with a lotion.

examples.text: Grace lotions her arms and legs and joins him in the large walk-in closet where they change out of their clothes and into their pajamas—loose-fitting cotton bottoms for Mike and a lace-trimmed baby doll nightie for Grace.
I would finish my daily ranging session by lotioning his legs, and lotioning and rubbing his feet.

Any oily or fatty matter.

Inflammation of a horse's heels, also known as scratches or pastern dermatitis.
Money.

examples.text: Some of the people I talked to said it could be done—but it would cost big money. More grease than I’d ever dreamed of.

glosses: To put grease or fat on something, especially in order to lubricate.
To bribe.

examples.text: the greas'd advocate that grinds the poor

glosses: To cause to go easily; to facilitate.
To perform a landing extraordinarily smoothly.

examples.text: To my amazement, I greased the landing despite the tricky crosswinds.
